<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Aura Shaping](/Feats.aspx?ID=4196) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 23

</column>

---

You control the size of your kinetic aura. You can make your kinetic aura's emanation any size from a 5-foot emanation to a 20-foot emanation (you must choose a multiple of 5). You choose the size when you [Channel Elements](/Actions.aspx?ID=2124) and can change it when you use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura. Increase the maximum size you can choose by 5 feet at 15th and 20th levels.
name: Aura Shaping
